✅ How to Choose the Right Whey as a Beginner
Key factors to consider:

list.snippet: Protein per serving: Beginners often do better with 12–20g initially.
Digestibility: Look for digestive enzymes or isolate-based whey if you get bloating.
Budget: Concentrates are cheaper; isolates cost more but digest easier.
Flavour & mixability: Important for consistency.
Testing & authenticity: Choose brands with batch testing (e.g., MuscleBlaze Biozyme, TrueBasics).
